verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken layout. The photo is cropped to a narrow strip in the middle of the canvas, so the praying hands are barely visible. The white cloud shapes float off to the left on white and look like stray fragments. The white quote box covers the bottom-right of the photo, and the left third of the canvas is dead white space. B is slightly worse because its cross marks are squashed and distorted (the cross on the hands looks compressed and the small crosses read as vertical ticks), while A keeps them intact.
